Container.Name: LibreChat
Container.Overview:
LibreChat is an open-source, self-hosted ChatGPT-style interface for many AI providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, AWS Bedrock, OpenRouter, Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible API. It supports agents, MCP servers, artifacts, code interpreter, file chat (RAG), web search, presets, conversation search, and multi-user login (email, OpenID/OAuth, LDAP).
**Before you install**
1. Run a MongoDB container (e.g. the official mongo image) and note its address. MongoDB 5+ needs a CPU with AVX; on older CPUs use mongo:4.4.18. 2. Generate the four secrets below at https://www.librechat.ai/toolkit/creds_generator or with `openssl rand -hex 32` (CREDS_KEY, JWT secrets) and `openssl rand -hex 16` (CREDS_IV). Logins fail without them, and changing CREDS_KEY/CREDS_IV later makes saved user API keys unreadable.
**Setup**
1. Set Client Domain and Server Domain to the exact URL you open LibreChat on (e.g. `http://192.168.1.10:3080` or `https://chat.example.com`). 2. Start the container and register. The first account is the admin. Then set Allow Registration to false if this is a private instance. 3. Provider keys set to `user_provided` let each user enter their own key in the UI. Put a real key in to share one key with everyone.
**Optional extras**
- Conversation search: run a Meilisearch container (getmeili/meilisearch), set Search to true and fill in its host and master key. - File chat (RAG): run the LibreChat RAG API (registry.librechat.ai/librechat-ai/librechat-rag-api-dev-lite) with a pgvector database and set RAG API URL. - Custom endpoints, MCP servers, model lists and interface settings live in `librechat.yaml`. Create the file in your appdata folder first (for example `/mnt/user/appdata/librechat/data/librechat.yaml`), then set Config Path to `/app/data/librechat.yaml`. Mapping a file that does not exist yet makes Docker create a folder and the app fails to start. - Every other setting from the upstream .env file can be added with "Add another Path, Port, Variable".
`host.docker.internal` points to your Unraid server (as in the upstream compose file), so a local Ollama can be reached at `http://host.docker.internal:11434`. Docs: https://www.librechat.ai/docs
Container.Requires: MongoDB container Optional: Meilisearch (conversation search), LibreChat RAG API + pgvector (file chat)

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: LibreChat web interface.

Config.Name: Images
Config.Description: Generated images and avatars.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Files users upload to chats and agents.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: App data and temporary credentials. A good place for librechat.yaml (see Config Path).

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Error and debug log files.

Config.Name: Skills
Config.Description: Agent skills folder (mounted the same way in the upstream docker-compose.yml).

Config.Name: Host Binding
Config.Description: Listen address. Keep 0.0.0.0 in Docker.

Config.Name: Client Domain
Config.Description: Required. The full URL you open LibreChat on, including http:// or https://. Replace the example IP.

Config.Name: Server Domain
Config.Description: Required. Usually the same as Client Domain.

Config.Name: MongoDB URI
Config.Description: Required. MongoDB connection string, e.g. mongodb://192.168.1.10:27017/LibreChat (add user:password@ if auth is enabled).

Config.Name: Credentials Key
Config.Description: Required. 64 hex characters (openssl rand -hex 32). Encrypts stored user API keys; do not change later.

Config.Name: Credentials IV
Config.Description: Required. 32 hex characters (openssl rand -hex 16).

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Required. 64 hex characters (openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: JWT Refresh Secret
Config.Description: Required. 64 hex characters (openssl rand -hex 32), different from JWT Secret.

Config.Name: Allow Registration
Config.Description: Allow new users to sign up. Register your admin account, then set this to false for a private instance.

Config.Name: Allow Email Login
Config.Description: Allow email and password login. Set to false when you only use SSO.

Config.Name: Allow Social Login
Config.Description: Enable OpenID/OAuth login buttons.

Config.Name: Allow Social Registration
Config.Description: Create accounts automatically on first OpenID/OAuth login.

Config.Name: Allow Password Reset
Config.Description: Enable password reset. Needs the email settings below.

Config.Name: Allow Unverified Email Login
Config.Description: Allow login before the email address is verified. Keep true unless email is configured.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: A shared key, user_provided (each user enters their own), or empty to hide the endpoint.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: A shared key, user_provided, or empty to hide the endpoint.

Config.Name: Google API Key
Config.Description: Gemini API key, user_provided, or empty to hide the endpoint.

Config.Name: Assistants API Key
Config.Description: OpenAI Assistants endpoint key, user_provided, or empty to hide it.

Config.Name: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: Used by an OpenRouter custom endpoint in librechat.yaml.

Config.Name: Enabled Endpoints
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list and order of endpoints, e.g. openAI,anthropic,google,agents,custom. Empty shows every configured endpoint.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Path or URL of librechat.yaml, e.g. /app/data/librechat.yaml after you create it in the Data folder. Empty uses /app/librechat.yaml (not present in the image).

Config.Name: Search (Meilisearch)
Config.Description: Enable conversation search. Needs a Meilisearch container.

Config.Name: Meilisearch Master Key
Config.Description: The MEILI_MASTER_KEY of your Meilisearch container.

Config.Name: Meilisearch No Analytics
Config.Description: Disable Meilisearch telemetry.

Config.Name: RAG API URL
Config.Description: URL of the LibreChat RAG API for file chat, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000

Config.Name: OpenID Issuer
Config.Description: SSO: issuer URL of your OpenID Connect provider (Authentik, Authelia, Kanidm, Keycloak...). Also set Allow Social Login to true.

Config.Name: OpenID Client ID
Config.Description: SSO client ID.

Config.Name: OpenID Client Secret
Config.Description: SSO client secret.

Config.Name: OpenID Session Secret
Config.Description: Random string for the SSO session (openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: OpenID Scope
Config.Description: Scopes requested from the provider.

Config.Name: OpenID Callback URL
Config.Description: Callback path. Register DOMAIN_SERVER + this path as the redirect URI at your provider.

Config.Name: OpenID Button Label
Config.Description: Text on the SSO login button.

Config.Name: OpenID Auto Redirect
Config.Description: Skip the login page and go straight to the SSO provider.

Config.Name: Email Host
Config.Description: SMTP server for password reset and verification emails.

Config.Name: Email Port
Config.Description: SMTP port, e.g. 587 or 465.

Config.Name: Email Encryption
Config.Description: Empty, starttls or tls.

Config.Name: Email Username
Config.Description: SMTP username.

Config.Name: Email Password
Config.Description: SMTP password.

Config.Name: Email From
Config.Description: Sender address, e.g. noreply@example.com

Config.Name: Email From Name
Config.Description: Sender name.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Number of reverse proxies in front of LibreChat (for correct client IPs and rate limits).

Config.Name: No Index
Config.Description: Ask search engines not to index the site.

Config.Name: App Title
Config.Description: Name shown in the browser tab and UI.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Write debug log files to the Logs folder.

Config.Name: Console JSON
Config.Description: Log to the console as JSON.

Config.Name: Temp Credentials Path
Config.Description: Where LibreChat keeps temporary credentials (same as the upstream compose file).
